layout_strategies.hero: Full-screen with parallax background image. Content aligned bottom-left or centered with heavy typography. Use a dark overlay (opacity 40%) on the image to ensure text readability.
layout_strategies.bento_grid: Use for Impact Metrics. A mix of 1x1 (stats), 2x1 (graphs), and 2x2 (maps) blocks. Gap-4 or Gap-6.
layout_strategies.editorial: For 'About' and 'Programs'. 50% width text, 50% width image, alternating rows. Large sticky headings on the left while content scrolls on the right.
layout_strategies.masonry: For 'Events' or 'Stories'. Uneven columns to create organic feel.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle 'noise' opacity-5 overlay to the #F1EFE9 background to give it a paper feel.
visual_enhancers.lines: Use 1px solid lines (#1B4332 opacity 10%) to separate sections. Create a grid-like feel in the background of data sections.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'Phosphor Icons' (Thin or Light weight) for a precise, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: npm install @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
THEME: Ensure 'Manrope' and 'Public Sans' are imported in index.css (via Google Fonts).
LAYOUT: Use a sticky header that changes background from Transparent (on Hero) to #1B4332 (on scroll).
ADMIN: The Admin Panel should feel distinct - cleaner, denser, white background, using Shadcn tables.
FORMS: Use Shadcn Form components but style them with the #2D6A6A focus ring.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use 'bg-black/40' overlays if needed.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
UNIVERSAL: Do NOT use generic gradients. Use solid blocks of color or subtle noise textures.
